svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.19.1.2 Vent Requirements
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.19 ROOF SPACES
Vent Requirements

g.text: Top: not less than 25% of the required
Bottom: not less than 25% of the required
Insulated ceiling area: the vent area is
Purlins not less than 38 mm × 38 mm (1½″ × 1½″)
on top of the roof joists interconnect the
Not needed where each joist space is
Clause (3)(b): at least 25% at the top,
Clause (3)(c): at least 25% at the bottom,
Sentence (2): slope less than 1 in 6, or roof

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as in Sentence (2), the unobstructed
vent area is not less than 1/300 of the
insulated ceiling area.
Where the roof slope is less than 1 in 6 or in
roofs constructed with roof joists, the
unobstructed vent area is not less than 1/150
of the insulated ceiling area.
Required vents may be roof, eave or gable-end
type, or any combination, and are distributed
(a) uniformly on opposite sides of the building,
(b) with not less than 25% of the required
openings at the top of the space, and (c) with
not less than 25% at the bottom of the space.
Except where each joist space is separately
vented, roof joist spaces are interconnected
by purlins not less than 38 mm by 38 mm (1½″ ×
1½″) on the top of the roof joists
Vents comply with CAN3-A93-M, "Natural Airflow
Ventilators for Buildings."
Drawn: A a steep roof cut between trusses, air flow in blue, B with sheathing cut back. The example is illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.19.1.2. (page 9-136)
